summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Pastasciutta Roma order management system. Backend APIs working correctly, frontend pages loading and navigation functional, but discovered critical issues with WebSocket real-time updates, timer functionality, and order deletion in UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Timer start button does not trigger timer properly - pause button doesn't appear after clicking play
Delete button clicks do not remove orders from grid view
Navigation from Bollitore to Generale via button fails with timeout

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connection consistently fails - 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established'
New orders may not appear immediately in UI after creation

passed_tests: Backend order CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Frontend Bollitore page order display with color coding
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix WebSocket connection issues preventing real-time updates. Debug timer functionality in Bollitore page where play/pause buttons don't work properly. Fix order deletion in Generale page - buttons are not removing orders from the UI. Ensure proper error handling for failed API calls in frontend.
